name: SAO Connector Library
description: Symbols, footprints, and 3D models for Shitty Add-On (SAO) badge connectors.
description_full:
Symbols, footprints, and 3D models for designing badges and add-ons that use the SAO (Shitty Add-On) connector standard: a 2x03, 2.54mm pitch IDC header carrying 3V3, GND, SDA, SCL, and two general-purpose pins.

Includes:
- SAO_Addon_Side: connector for the add-on board (the SAO itself)
- SAO_Badge_Side: mating connector for the host badge

After installing, go to Preferences > Packages and Updates > Library Package Handling and disable the nickname prefix before installing this package, so the footprint library is added as "SAO" rather than "PCM_SAO". This ensures each symbol's default footprint assignment resolves automatically with no extra setup.
